spans.s:
n. (-प्तः)
Sacrificing, offering oblations.
E.
आप to obtain, असुन् affix, and त inserted.

m. (-प्तुः)
1 The body.
2 A limb or member.
E.
आप to obtain, and तुन् Uṇādi aff.

Accused, prosecuted.
f. (-प्ता)
A twisted band or lock of hair.
n. (-प्तं)
1

Equation of a degree.
E.
आप to obtain, क्त aff.

m. (-री)
A trusty agent, a confidential servant.
E.
आप्त trusted, and कारिन् who acts.

mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं)
Proud, arrogant.
E.
आप्त and गर्ब्ब pride.

f. (-र्भा)
A pregnant woman.
E.
आप्त and गर्भ embryo.

n. (-नं)
A received text, an authority.
E.
आप्त and वचन text.

f. (-प्तिः)
1 Gain, acquisition.
2 Binding, joining.
3 Connexion, relation.
4 Fitness, aptitude.
E.
आप to obtain, क्तिन् aff.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 An augment or affix, (in grammar.)
2 A word of received acceptation, and established by usage only.
E.
आप्त received, उक्ति speech.
